items.description: Run the repo test gate, recording host unit-test and firmware structural regression evidence.
items.evidence: just test passed: host scheduler logic unit tests passed, including long-running event slot regression cases; firmware interrupt regression checks passed.

items.description: Run or confirm the hardware regression layer for this release candidate.
items.skipReason: Release operator determined this scheduler elapsed-time width fix is low risk enough that additional hardware testing does not block release; connected Arducon hardware already confirmed corrected power-up synchronization behavior.

items.description: Build and validate the release package.
items.evidence: just package and just validate passed for release-packages/Arducon-v2.1.1: update HEX 0x0000..0x7B43 (31556 bytes), first-install HEX 0x0000..0x7FFF (32064 bytes), bootloader HEX 0x7E00..0x7FFF (508 bytes), release ZIP validated.

items.description: Verify the expected release package outputs exist under release-packages.
items.evidence: Verified 11 expected package files exist under release-packages/Arducon-v2.1.1: update HEX, first-install HEX, Optiboot HEX, Optiboot source ZIP, Prepare-Arducon-Updates script, provision-bootloader script, test-bootloader-serial script, manifest JSON, checksums TXT, README TXT, and complete release ZIP.

items.description: Verify the published GitHub release title, notes, tag, standalone update HEX, and ZIP.
